description: Single source of the Phase 9 rasterizer perf-regression baselines. scripts/check-raster-perf-baseline.sh diffs a measured BenchmarkDotNet run (its full JSON export) against this file's per-benchmark 'baselineMs', gated by 'toleranceFraction' (or a benchmark's own override): measured <= baselineMs * (1 + toleranceFraction) passes; a measured time over that band fails unless justified. Independently of any live measurement, the script also runs the SSIM-LOOSEN-shaped governance check: a diff that raises any baselineMs/toleranceFraction value (loosening the gate) must carry a 'PERF-LOOSEN:' commit-message token, mirroring scripts/check-ssim-threshold.sh exactly; tightening (lowering a value) always passes freely.
runner: same-platform-only (mirroring the SSIM gate's own constraint): every number below is measured on the CI runner platform (linux-x64, GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest). Hosted runners vary in CPU model and neighbour load, so each benchmark's tolerance is sized from the spread of the per-commit gate's own ShortRun readings, not from the calibration run's variance.
calibrationNote: baselineMs is the mean of a multi-run statistical calibration, raster-perf-calibration run 36529163370 (2026-09-29, main 6c35d82, ubuntu-latest linux-x64, net8.0, full default BenchmarkDotNet job). toleranceFraction is set per benchmark so the limit clears the slowest of the last eight per-commit raster-perf-gate readings (ci.yml, --job short) with margin: those readings ran up to ~1.8x the calibrated mean on single-threaded pages and ~2.6x on the parallel suite, because hosted runners differ. Every effective limit is lower than before this calibration; the previous baselines predated the raster performance sprint and allowed roughly a 2x regression to pass. Re-run .github/workflows/raster-perf-calibration.yml after any deliberate performance change and re-derive both numbers the same way.

RasterizeBenchmarks.RasterizeTextHeavyPa.description: 55 short paragraphs (~9pt) on one A4 page at 2048px width — glyph-shaping and glyph-rasterization throughput. Calibrated mean 43.2 ms; limit 64.8 ms at tolerance 0.5 (slowest recent per-commit reading 50.8 ms).

RasterizeBenchmarks.RasterizeImageHeavyP.description: Six distinct 300x200 gradient images stacked on one A4 page at 2048px width — image-XObject decode/blit throughput. Calibrated mean 51.2 ms; limit 81.9 ms at tolerance 0.6 (slowest recent per-commit reading 69.4 ms).

RasterizeBenchmarks.RasterizeTransparenc.description: A rotated watermark plus four partially-transparent corner stamps over body content, one A4 page at 2048px width — alpha-compositing throughput. The calibration run reported a bimodal distribution, hence the wider tolerance. Calibrated mean 11.6 ms; limit 25.5 ms at tolerance 1.2 (slowest recent per-commit reading 21.1 ms).

RasterizeBenchmarks.RasterizeFourDocumen.description: Four independent PdfDocument.Open + Rasterize calls (each its own scratch ObjectRegistry) racing via Parallel.For — wall-clock throughput, the widest tolerance since a shared runner's core count and neighbour load move parallel throughput far more than single-threaded work. Concurrency correctness is proven separately by the raster-concurrency-stress pixel-identity lane. Calibrated mean 63.9 ms; limit 191.7 ms at tolerance 2.0 (slowest recent per-commit reading 166.8 ms).

RasterizeBenchmarks.RasterizeJpxScanPage.description: A self-contained one-page PDF (composed byte-wise in [GlobalSetup], no corpus dependency) placing a 640x480 JPEG 2000 scan (9/7 irreversible, ICT, tiled RPCL) full-page — JPX decode-and-paint throughput. Calibrated mean 102.4 ms; limit 163.8 ms at tolerance 0.6 (slowest recent per-commit reading 141.5 ms).

RasterizeBenchmarks.RasterizeScanPageMin.description: A self-contained one-page scan-shaped placement rendered through the minify (box-filter) regime — the resampling knob's minify path. Calibrated mean 36.8 ms; limit 62.6 ms at tolerance 0.7 (slowest recent per-commit reading 55.3 ms).

RasterizeBenchmarks.RasterizeScanPageMag.description: The same scan-shaped placement rendered through the magnify (bilinear/nearest) regime — the resampling knob's magnify path. Calibrated mean 23.1 ms; limit 43.9 ms at tolerance 0.9 (slowest recent per-commit reading 39.3 ms).
